test.name: Schuylkill County, PA records guide for 1840s-1860s research
test.description: Provide a research-records guide for Schuylkill County in the 1840s-1860s. Tests whether the skill consults the place_search/locality_survey's collections part/locality_survey's externalLinks part/locality_survey's volumes part MCP tools and produces a guide that names specific record classes, repositories, time-period-aware caveats (e.g., that Pennsylvania didn't register vital records statewide until 1906), and the unindexed volumes locality_survey's volumes part surfaces.

input.delegation:
What records are available for genealogical research in Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania in the 1840s-1860s?

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should identify the record classes the tool results give for the 1840s-1860s: the 1850-1860 federal census, church records (the Lutheran volume and the Schuylkill County church collection) and probate records. Do not require Catholic parishes, tax assessments or naturalization records: no fixture names them for Schuylkill County in this period.

No tool result gives the year Pennsylvania's statewide vital registration began; the wiki pages the survey reads here are generic content. A guide that says civil registration for the period was not confirmed by this survey, and points to church registers for births, marriages and deaths, meets this. A guide that says statewide civil registration existed in the 1840s-1860s fails.
Should reference the collections-search-schuylkill fixture data to name actual FamilySearch collections, not generic record-type names

No fixture names a repository beyond FamilySearch for Schuylkill County; the generic wiki page mentions county courthouses and state archives only in general terms. Do not require a named repository such as the Schuylkill County Historical Society or the Pennsylvania State Archives. A guide that names one no tool result gave is making an unsourced claim.

Should use locality_survey's volumes part to surface the digitized-but-unindexed Lutheran church records volume (recordSearchablePercent 0, fulltextSearchable false) as browse-only — image-by-image access, not name-searchable

Should distinguish the probate records volume (recordSearchablePercent 4, fulltextSearchable true) as full-text searchable but not name-indexed, separately from the census volume (recordSearchablePercent 96) which is fully indexed

Must NOT report only the indexed locality_survey's collections part results while staying silent on the unindexed locality_survey's volumes part findings — that would understate what's actually digitized and available to browse

The guide is the saved localities entry: its guide_markdown and its record_types, repositories, losses and catalog rows; grade them together. When research_append refuses the place as not in FamilySearch's place standard, the guide is the return instead.
